aboutPage.pageTitle: About Actaer: Software Product Company in Serbia
aboutPage.pageDescription: Learn about Actaer, founded in 2025 — a software product company in Novi Pazar, Serbia. We build VantumIQP and FaberPDF and run a consulting practice for AI, software development, and digital modernization.
aboutPage.heroDescription: We're a product company with a consulting practice. We build software people rely on every day — and we help other businesses put AI and modern technology to work.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Actaer is a software product company from Novi Pazar, Serbia. We build VantumIQP, a governed business-intelligence workspace, and FaberPDF, a local-first PDF editor — and we help other companies put AI and modern technology to work through our consulting practice.
story.paragraph2: Behind those products is a founding team with experience in enterprise software, startups, and consulting. We know what works, what fails, and why many tech projects do not succeed.
story.paragraph3: As a new firm, we offer fresh views and modern methods — free from old ideas. We partner with businesses of all sizes to build software that works well, grows as needed, and adds true value.
story.paragraph4: Our products, VantumIQP and FaberPDF, embody everything we believe about software: modern, user-friendly, and built for how businesses actually operate today.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: The principles that guide everything we do.

resultsDriven.title: Results-Driven
resultsDriven.description: We measure success by the impact we create for our clients, not by hours logged or lines of code written.

clientCentric.title: Client-Centric
clientCentric.description: Your success is our success. We build long-term partnerships based on trust, transparency, and mutual growth.

innovationFocused.title: Innovation-Focused
innovationFocused.description: We stay at the forefront of technology, bringing cutting-edge solutions to solve your most challenging problems.

collaborative.title: Collaborative
collaborative.description: We work as an extension of your team, fostering open communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To empower businesses with technology that actually works. We're on a mission to eliminate the gap between what technology promises and what it delivers.
mission.quote: We build software we stand behind — and help others do the same.

aiConsultingPage.pageDescription: AI strategy and roadmaps, model selection, agentic automation and team enablement. Practical AI consulting from a company that builds software products.
aiConsultingPage.heroTitle: Put AI to work where it earns its keep
aiConsultingPage.heroDescription: We help companies move from AI curiosity to AI in production — strategy, pilots, automation and the training your teams need to keep it running.
aiConsultingPage.offering1Description: Where AI creates value in your business, what to build vs. buy, and a sequenced plan your board can sign off on.
aiConsultingPage.offering2Description: Model and vendor selection, integration with your existing systems, and evaluation that goes beyond the demo.
aiConsultingPage.offering3Description: Agentic workflows for document processing, reporting and operations — deployed with guardrails, not hype.
aiConsultingPage.offering4Description: Hands-on workshops that leave your engineers and operators able to run and extend what we build.
aiConsultingPage.whyTitle: Advice backed by products we ship
aiConsultingPage.whyDescription: VantumIQP and FaberPDF keep us honest: we deal with data governance, deployment and support every day. That experience — not a methodology binder — is what we bring to your AI initiative.

softwareDevelopmentPage.offering4Description: Maintenance, monitoring and iteration after launch — we don't ship and vanish.

digitalModernizationPage.offering1Description: An honest map of what you run today, what it costs you, and what to change first.
digitalModernizationPage.offering2Description: Turning manual, paper-driven workflows into digital ones your staff actually adopt.
digitalModernizationPage.offering3Description: Selecting and rolling out the right tools — BI, document management, automation — without shelfware.
digitalModernizationPage.offering4Description: We work alongside your people so the capability stays when the engagement ends.

vantumiqpPage.pageDescription: Governed dashboards, SQL reporting, and 40+ charts on Apache Superset. VantumIQP turns data questions into answers your company can trust. Book a demo.
vantumiqpPage.heroTitle: Your data has a story. Finally see it.
vantumiqpPage.heroDescription: You have the data. What you need are answers — governed, traceable, ready to share. VantumIQP is the business intelligence platform that gets you there, built on Apache Superset.
vantumiqpPage.featuresTitle: From question to answer, without the detours
vantumiqpPage.feature1Description: From bar charts to sankeys — every answer gets the visualization it deserves.
vantumiqpPage.feature2Description: Explore in SQL without switching tools. Every chart stays traceable to its query.
vantumiqpPage.feature3Description: Role-aware dashboards with row-level access. The right people see the right data.
vantumiqpPage.feature4Description: Reusable, documented datasets — the whole company answers from one source of truth.
vantumiqpPage.feature5Description: Exploration stays exploratory. Reports stay reliable. VantumIQP keeps them apart.
vantumiqpPage.feature6Description: All the power of Apache Superset. None of the rough edges.
vantumiqpPage.showcaseTitle: Real dashboards. Real SQL. No mockups.
vantumiqpPage.showcaseDashboardAlt: VantumIQP governed dashboard built on Apache Superset
vantumiqpPage.showcaseSqlAlt: SQL editor in VantumIQP with every chart traceable to its query
vantumiqpPage.showcaseVisualAlt: Chart builder in the VantumIQP business intelligence workspace
vantumiqpPage.audienceTitle: For teams tired of babysitting their BI tool
vantumiqpPage.audienceDescription: If stakeholders keep asking what the numbers mean — or where they came from — VantumIQP is for you. Demo access only for now: we start with your use case, not a checkout page.
vantumiqpPage.ctaTitle: See VantumIQP on your own data
vantumiqpPage.ctaDescription: Bring one real reporting problem to the demo. Leave with it solved.

faberpdfPage.pageTitle: FaberPDF — Local-First PDF Editor for Windows & Linux
faberpdfPage.pageDescription: Sign, edit, and validate PDFs without uploading them anywhere. FaberPDF is the offline PDF editor that keeps documents on your desktop. Free during beta.
faberpdfPage.heroDescription: Every 'free' online PDF tool has a price: your contracts on someone else's server. FaberPDF signs, edits, and validates PDFs entirely on your desktop. No uploads. Ever.
faberpdfPage.featuresTitle: Everything you send PDFs to the cloud for. Minus the cloud.
faberpdfPage.feature1Description: Contracts and forms, signed on your machine — not on a stranger's server.
faberpdfPage.feature2Description: Mark up, comment, highlight. Reviews that keep pace with your thinking.
faberpdfPage.feature3Description: Edit text directly in the PDF. Small corrections shouldn't need a round-trip.
faberpdfPage.feature4Description: Validate integrity and standards conformance before you hit send.
faberpdfPage.feature5Description: Native desktop builds. No browser tab pretending to be an app.
faberpdfPage.feature6Description: Version 0.1.0 is free to try — and your feedback shapes what ships next.
faberpdfPage.privacyTitle: The safest upload is the one that never happens
faberpdfPage.privacyDescription: Invoices, contracts, medical records — the PDFs you handle are exactly the files that should never touch a third-party server. FaberPDF does the work where your files already live: on your desktop.
faberpdfPage.ctaDescription: Free during beta, for Windows and Linux. Your documents will thank you.
